about: yaac tool calls made by the real harnesses in the live check of 2026-11-20 (Codex CLI 0.170.0 with app-server daemon 0.171.0, model gpt-6.2-sol at low effort; Claude Code 2.1.329 via the Agent SDK, model alias haiku at low effort). Arguments as the harness sent them; addresses replaced by placeholders <self>, <peer>, <worker>. The call metadata Codex attached to every call had the fields progressToken, callId, x-codex-turn-metadata, threadId, sessionId, windowId, itemId (threadId equal to the calling thread); Claude Code's had progressToken and claudecode/toolUseId.

calls.instruction: Send a message to the other thread saying hello.
